== Course of events ==

After the Gump crashed into a mountain cliff and broke its wings, leaving the travelers stranded and uncertain of their course, The Scarecrow put forward a proposal: the group should seek the counsel of Glinda the Good in the South Country. With this plan agreed upon, the party boarded the Gump once more, preparing to resume their journey under new direction.

The decision to consult Glinda the Good set the travelers back on course. Boarding the Gump, the group departed toward the south, the craft carrying them onward through the night and into the following dawn, past the borders of the Land of Oz and into unfamiliar territory beyond.
